synthetic_four_group_diagnosis.interpretation: All four intended strings must be correct simultaneously. Legacy label metrics compare the complete observed same-pitch mask separately with each singleton label, so legacy 51027/310640 and 3234746/19879820 do not measure simultaneous four-string coverage. Native group snapshot and the raw union-of-concurrent-labels metric both measure zero. Historical scoreboard and frozen gates remain unchanged; this is a separate diagnostic measurement.

simultaneous_group_metric.code_state: local uncommitted reporting change; active corpus source remains pinned
simultaneous_group_metric.semantics: Union concurrent same-pitch annotation masks over intervals with a constant active-label set. Exact coverage requires every intended string at once, with no extra or unassigned lane. Unknown mask-zero membership is unmeasured and excluded from known totals.
simultaneous_group_metric.interpretation: Each group is one pitch over a constant set of active annotations. Known string masks are unioned, so simultaneous singleton labels count once. An exact group requires every intended lane at the same time, no extra lane for that pitch and no unassigned voice. Any zero-mask annotation leaves string membership unmeasured and excludes that interval from exact-group totals. Different pitches can overlap in group-sample totals; these are not unique audio duration, snapshot scores, all-pitch chord accuracy or host delivery. False outputs remain separate. Legacy per-label scores are unchanged.
simultaneous_group_metric.gate_policy: Parallel metric only; frozen acceptance gates and historical scores unchanged.
simultaneous_group_metric.next: Use the additive group metric in a future justified corpus run; do not relaunch the current pinned run to add it.
